strategy.name: qqq_stochrsi_true124_position_gate_comparison
strategy.description: Correct TIM-v0.80a.3's mother-selection mismatch and compare the user's true strategy 1, strategy 2 and strategy 4. Mother 1 is the frozen D0_F0_S0 accumulation and dual-pool process. Mother 2 is frozen D0_F1_S1, which adds the short- and long-period sparse recovery entries. Mother 4 is the pruned accumulation process: normal and extreme oversold entries are capped at 15% and 30% QQQ weight, two strict 0.20 recovery crossings buy remaining cash, Pool A is the sole staged exit mechanism, and a strict StochRSI100 downcross below 0.20 exits the residual position. Each mother produces three independent fixed-capital all-in-or-cash accounts based on whether the mother's completed same-Close QQQ weight is strictly greater than 70%, 80% or 90%.
strategy.buy_rule: Mother 1 and Mother 2 preserve their frozen rules. Mother 4 buys 5% of remaining cash on each Close with both StochRSI42 and StochRSI100 below 0.20, capped at 15% QQQ weight; on the more extreme asymmetric 0.01/0.05 condition it instead buys 20% of remaining cash, capped at 30% total QQQ weight. It also buys 40% of remaining cash on a strict StochRSI42 upcross above 0.20 while StochRSI100 is above 0.20, or 50% on a strict StochRSI100 upcross above 0.20; the long-period 50% rule supersedes the short-period rule on the same Close. A gate buys all-in QQQ when its source mother's completed post-trade QQQ weight is strictly greater than its threshold.
strategy.sell_rule: Mother 1 and Mother 2 preserve their frozen dual-pool exits. In Mother 4, every Close with StochRSI100 above 0.80 adds 1% of currently held shares to Pool A. After Pool A has started, a strict StochRSI100 downcross below 0.50 sells Pool A only and clears it. A strict downcross below 0.20 has priority, sells all remaining QQQ and clears Pool A. Any sale blocks same-Close buys. A gate sells all QQQ whenever the source mother's completed post-trade weight is not strictly greater than its threshold; equality is cash.
strategy.signal_time: All StochRSI levels, strict crossings, position caps and mother post-trade QQQ weights use completed current adjusted-Close data. A gate reads its mother's deterministic completed post-trade weight on that same Close.
strategy.execution_time: All Mother 4 and gate orders execute at the same adjusted Close that confirms the signal, with zero transaction cost. Mother 1 and Mother 2 retain their previously frozen execution rules, including their theoretical fast-drop exception; gates never inherit that theoretical price.
strategy.positioning: Long-only fractional QQQ and cash. Every account starts with $100,000. Mother 1 and Mother 2 may add external cash only under their frozen minimum-buy rules and each is paired with contribution-matched QQQ Buy & Hold. Mother 4 and all nine gate accounts never add external cash. Gates copy only a binary position signal, not mother cash flows or position size.

plain_language.summary: 纠正上一版的母策略编号，比较真正的策略1、策略2和精简后的累计仓位策略4，并把三者的仓位转换成全仓或空仓信号。
plain_language.buy: 三条母策略按各自规则增加QQQ；九条独立择时账户只在对应母策略的QQQ仓位严格高于70%、80%或90%时全仓买入。
plain_language.sell: 三条母策略按各自规则减仓；择时账户一旦不再严格高于门槛，就把QQQ全部卖出并持有现金。
plain_language.execution: 当天收盘确认并按当天收盘成交；母策略先完成交易，择时账户再读取母策略当天收盘后的仓位。
plain_language.position: 所有账户从10万美元开始；两个原累计策略的必要追加现金只同步进入各自基准，精简策略和九条全仓空仓账户不追加本金。

mother_strategies.definition: Pruned accumulation with capped oversold entries, recovery entries, Pool A only and deep-failure exit

parameters.gate_signal_source: mother post-trade QQQ market value divided by mother equity on the same Close
parameters.gate_capital_policy: independent fixed $100,000 initial capital; no external contributions
parameters.final_comparison_paths: nine position gates plus naive QQQ Buy & Hold

holding_period_cagr.definition: geometric time compression of calendar CAGR over the fraction of trading sessions with shares greater than zero
holding_period_cagr.interpretation: descriptive intensity metric, not a separately simulated return or subperiod IRR

parameters.performance_return_method_with_flows: daily time-weighted returns; XIRR also reported

financing: No leverage or borrowing. Only Mother 1 and Mother 2's frozen minimum-buy shortfalls may add external cash; Mother 4 and all gates cannot.
benchmark: Mother 1 and Mother 2 each have contribution-matched QQQ Buy & Hold. Mother 4 and all nine fixed-capital gates compare directly with naive QQQ Buy & Hold.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged. Add holding-period CAGR to the result table and preserve the mother-group equity, capital and final ten-line comparison panels.

research.hypothesis: The user's pruned strategy 4 may preserve a cleaner trend-membership signal than the mistakenly substituted four-state process, and the holding-period CAGR can show the geometric return intensity of each binary gate while exposure remains explicit.
research.primary_metric: For the nine fixed-capital gates: calendar CAGR, holding-period CAGR, holding-time fraction, Sharpe, maximum drawdown and average exposure versus naive QQQ. For Mother 1 and Mother 2: cash-flow-adjusted CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown and XIRR versus contribution-matched Buy & Hold.
research.selection_rule: Report all 12 predeclared strategy paths without selecting a winner. The nine gates are the only common-capital final comparison. Holding-period CAGR must always be shown beside calendar CAGR and exposure and cannot be used alone to rank paths.
research.validation_plan: Reconcile every mother and gate order, daily cash, shares, equity and FIFO trade against compiled PyBroker replay; verify Mother 4 caps, buy priority, Pool A exclusivity, deep-failure priority, strict gate equality, no gate contributions and the holding-period CAGR identity.
research.promotion_criteria: A gate is a rotation-signal candidate only if its calendar return, drawdown, exposure and holding-period return intensity are jointly useful versus naive QQQ and it does not depend on external contributions.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject any path if reconciliation fails, Mother 4 exceeds a frozen low-entry cap because of that entry, Mother 4 retains deleted Pool B or residual-sale logic, a gate receives external cash, equality enters QQQ, or holding-period CAGR is calculated from average dollar weight instead of time with any position.
